source: RI-JRN01 §C O6-O10 (creation is a scene); RI-CHR01 §1 (what is asked and by whom)
note: This is the character creation UI. There is no other one. Every node has a speaker who is a record in npcs/writ-house.json, a line in that speaker's voice, and — where the node sets a field — the player's reply is the input. No node is a menu, a slider, a step counter or a confirmation screen.

nodes.speaker: jeeh-ei
nodes.note: RI-JRN01 O6, and the one thing the round-1 verdict said this opening loses to Morrowind outright: 'you spend two minutes being a body first'. The scene used to START at hold.hatch-name, so the first character-defining question was on the frame at frame 0 and first_control never arrived before it. This node hands control back the moment the hold loads: Jeeh-Ei is sitting there, the knife and the tithe-gourd are on the crates, and she says nothing until you walk over and talk to her. Nothing is explained and nothing is pressed. `resume_by: talk` is what the engine waits for; hold.out's `resume_by: walk` is the same mechanism at the other end of the hold.

nodes.speaker: jeeh-ei
nodes.line: You're awake. Good. They don't like waking you at the desk, it makes the writing slow.

nodes.speaker: jeeh-ei
nodes.line: They will take the other one off you at the writ house. Tell me the one they cannot.
nodes.on_answer: %HatchName. I will not say it again where they can hear it, and neither will you, and one day a stranger will say it to you and you will know what they are.
nodes.on_refusal: No. That is right. I should not have asked and you should not have said. I will remember that you did not.

nodes.speaker: jeeh-ei
nodes.line: Go up. The light is bad but it is light. When you are done at the desk, come back down here if I am still here.
nodes.note: `resume`/`resume_by` were implicit before: Census.enter() jumped to a hardcoded 'writ.enter' and the engine tested one hardcoded z. Two nodes now hand control back, in the same hold, resumed by different acts, so the target and the act both live in the graph where a reader can see them.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: Stand where the light is. I have to be able to see you to write you down.

input.note: Race is not asked. It is OBSERVED — the scribe looks up, writes something, and reads it back to you wrongly. The player's only input at this node is the correction.

saxhleel.line: Naga, then. — No. No, you are not, are you. Marsh-form. I have had three of them through here this morning and I have stopped looking properly.

naga.line: Saxhleel. — Ah. No. Naga. I will write it correctly and you will notice that I do not write it twice.

dunmer.line: Altmer. — No, of course not, you are not tall enough and you are not smug enough. Dunmer. I will write Dunmer.

imperial.line: Breton. — No. Imperial. It is the vowels; the Office has never taught a clerk here the difference and I have given up asking.

nord.line: Orsimer. — No. Nord. In this light and at that height it is an honest mistake and you may take it however you like.

breton.line: Imperial. — No. Breton. The Office writes Imperial for both and I do not, and that is the whole of my rebellion.

redguard.line: Nord. — No. Redguard. I am sorry. It has been a long list and every tall man is a Nord by the afternoon.

khajiit.line: Bosmer. — No. Khajiit. There is a box for that and the box has a second line under it and I am going to leave the second line empty.

orsimer.line: Nord. — No. Orsimer. The Office form says Orc. I am writing Orsimer and if it comes back I will write it again.

bosmer.line: Khajiit. — No. Bosmer. Everyone from the Blackwood side gets asked that and everyone from the Blackwood side hates it.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: And I have to put something in this box, because the box is there. It changes nothing. Nothing in this province will treat you differently for it and I have watched for eleven years.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: Where were you a child? Answer in the name of a water, not a country.

options.scribe: The interior. I will write the marsh. There are people here who will read that and stand up straighter, and people who will read it and count their doors.
Lukiul. So am I. It is a word other people use about us and I have stopped flinching at it, which took about six years.

options.text: A river you have not heard of.
options.scribe: Foreign-born. Then everything here will be explained to you badly by people who think they are being kind.
Blackrose. Guard's family or inmate's, and I am not going to ask which, and neither will most people, and the ones who do ask will be the ones you have to watch.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.note: RI-CHR01 §3: a game that permits an odd combination and then never notices it has permitted nothing.

branches.line: Stop. A Dunmer raised in the deep marsh. — I have written this once before and the once was a mistake in the hand, not in the man. So it is true. A raid went badly and the kin who found what was left did not do the obvious thing with it. You will be hated in Helstrom by people who will feed you first.

A Saxhleel who has never stood in the marsh. — Then you will find out this month what the rest of us found out at hatching, and you will find it out in front of an audience. The Deep-Kin will call you lukiul and they will be wrong in a way you cannot argue with.

A Khajiit born at Blackrose. — Then either your mother wore the Ninth Cohort's coat or she wore its irons, and there is a man on the gate at Blackrose who will know which the moment he sees your face, and he is the only one who will.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: And the name they will use.
nodes.on_answer: %PCName. Two hundred and fifty gold at any Provincial Office if you decide you were wrong, once, and the old one stays legible under the line.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: Profession. There are three ways to do this and I do not care which, and neither does the box.

options.text: Name a trade the Office already has a word for.
Tell her what you actually do.
Ask me something instead. I do not know what to call it.

nodes.presentation_rule: RI-CHR01 §4: the custom route is offered SECOND, in the scribe's own words, and is never labelled advanced, expert or custom to the player. The questionnaire route is mandatory and always offered.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: Then say the words and I will write the words. The Office will not know what they mean and neither will I, and in a year a stranger in a market will say them back to you.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: What has carried you this far?

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: And what has not. Everyone has two. If you tell me you have none I will write down the two I can see from here.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: Three things you have done often enough that your hands do them before you do.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: And two more you would not be ashamed to be asked to do.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: Then sit. I will ask you ten things and none of them is any of my business, and at the end of it I will have a word for you, and it will be a better word than the one you would have picked.
nodes.on_match_named_class: That is a %ClassName. That is exactly a %ClassName. I have written eleven of them this year and not one of them said the word to me first.
nodes.on_nearest_named_class: %ClassName. Not to the letter — none are, and the ones who are worry me — but of the words I am allowed to write, that is the one nearest to what you just told me. %ClassName. You will hear it said back to you and you will not like it the first time.
nodes.on_no_match: I do not have a word for that. I am going to write what you told me and let the next person along argue with it.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma

route_lines.named: %ClassName, then, in your own mouth first. That is a word the Office already has, so it goes in the box exactly as you said it and no clerk in Gideon will have to think about it. Not all get that. Most of what walks in here has to be rounded.
route_lines.custom: %ClassName. There is no box for that, so I have cut one, and in a year a factor in Lilmoth will read it off your case and have no idea what it means and will have to ask you. That is the best outcome available from this desk.

nodes.note: RI-CHR01 §4 calls the naming 'the moment the route is for', and the round-1 verdict is that the game 'never tells you what you are': fourteen classes computed, all fourteen reachable, the right one 96.25% of the time, and NAMED_line drawn 0% of the time with a coupling of 0. The cause was structural. The naming lines — on_match_named_class and its two siblings — were pushed into `spoken`, which is the one thing on the panel the height cap was allowed to sacrifice, and it sacrificed them at every node they appeared at. A line that matters is a node's own `line`, which is never sacrificed, on a beat the player closes themselves. That is also exactly what Morrowind does with it: Socucius Ergalla says the word, you press on. All three routes pass through here, so the moment does not belong to the questionnaire alone.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: Which tide were you drawn on?
nodes.foreign_note: If you name an Imperial sign instead — the Warrior, the Lady, the Atronach — she converts it onto the marsh's chart, writes the marsh answer, and does not care that you disagree.
nodes.imperial_answer_line: That is a star. Stars are for people who look up. Here the question is what the root under the pool was doing on the day, and I will decide which of ours yours was, and I will be right.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: Two-Drink. Then say the second one, and understand me: you will have half of what it gives and all of what it costs. The Office is not being cruel. It is what the sap did.

nodes.speaker: warden-scribe-tuleeh-ma
nodes.line: %PCName. %Race. %Upbringing. %ClassName. %Birthsign. — Reed-case, stamped, and it is the only thing in this province that says you are a person rather than a shape that was seen. Do not lose it. The door behind me is the one you want. Past it, no one tells you a thing you have not asked for. So ask them what they do, and what is being said here. It is the only part of this province that is free.
nodes.note: The last thing said in the opening, and the beat where RI-DLG01 §A's nine root topics are actually put in the player's hands (`Engine._censusFinish()` -> `learnTopics`). The line teaches the VERB and nothing else: no place is named, no direction is given beyond the door in the room, and no surface is pointed at. ARBITRATION S35 permits a map that records where you have been and forbids one that instructs you where to go, and closes with the clause this line is written to satisfy — 'wayfinding must still work without opening the map at all: signposts, spoken directions and landmarks are unaffected, because a map that shows only where you have already been cannot get you anywhere new.' Measured before this round: the opening's 22 nodes contained no sentence telling the player that asking is a thing you do, and the nine words you would ask with were held by nobody and answerable by nobody in the room.

greetings_race_conditioned.note: A worked sample of RI-CHR02 §4c channel 1. The full 300-cell, 1,500-line pool is owned by W1-11.

lines: You came up out of the same water we did. Sit down, you are dripping on the floor and it does not matter.
Root and river. Say what you need.
Warmblood. You are standing in a village that counts its children every morning because of your House.
There is nothing here you can buy and none here who will take your hand.
Walk back the way you came while the light is still on the path.
You are not the one we are watching for. That is all the welcome there is.
Hands where the light is. Both of them.
You are a long way from a river, and I am going to keep saying so until you are back at one.
Stock walks itself into the yard now. Saves the nets.
Whose are you? You are owned. Everything with scales out here is owned.
Serjo. Sit, there is wine, the wine is real and it came in with the salt.
One of ours. You will not believe the season we are having.

slavery_lines_sample.note: A worked sample of RI-CHR02 §4c channel 5 (floor: 60 lines, >= 12 addressed to a Dunmer player). Shipped here: 12, of which 5 are addressed to a Dunmer player. The remainder is W1-11's.

lines.text: Do not take the coast road past the Salt Hills alone. I am not being dramatic. I am telling you what happened to my sister's crew in Hearthfire.
If a Dres factor asks you for your writ, you show it. If he asks you for it twice, you run, because the second asking is not about the writ.
You are marked already? Show me. — Ah. Owned, then. Move along, I do not poach.
They took four off the Hive last month and the Office wrote it down as a hiring.
The Twin Lamps are real and they are not a story for children. When you need them you will already know the words.
I could get you papers. Real ones. I could also get four hundred for you at Archon, and I want you to know that I thought about it and decided against it.
Serjo. There is a berth on the Sallow Wife and a share in what she carries north, and the work is one week and the share is obscene.
You will eat here because we do not starve a guest. You will not sleep here. Do not ask me twice.
Congratulations on the season. It's what you say, is it not, to each other, when the nets come back full.
I have buried nine this year that your House put in the water. I'll still take your fee. It's what the Court is for, and I hate it as much as you should.
My cousin's boy. Eight. If you hear a name — any name — in a factor's house, you come and find me and I will not ask you why you were in a factor's house.
It is legal in Morrowind, which means it is legal on a Morrowind deck, which means it is legal about a hundred yards off that beach. Yes. I know.
